proof_summary: Split into the cases \(n>122\) and \(1\le n\le122\). In the first case, positivity supplies a counted twin pair whose smaller prime \(p\) satisfies \(n^2+1\le p\le (n+1)^2-3\), hence \(n^2<p<(n+1)^2\); in the second, a finite list of explicit prime witnesses establishes the same bounds for every \(n\).
